items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played a gig with Henry… the bass player, Henry…

ctx.x: "Damn!" I mean intense. Intense! I wish I had a recorder to record it. It was amazing. I mean Don was like a totally broken, free,… and Milford! I've never heard anything like that my life. I mean it was totally different and intense! I mean Milford. If you heard Milford play… Milford now is doing this scientific thing with heartbeats and rhythms and stuff. He's in some deep stuff. But Milford was like something else. In a class all by himself with what he did. But that… left a deep, really good impression about…
